Its purpose is to give infrastructure teams a clearer understanding of the current environment and identify areas requiring attention.

items.title: When should we carry out a data centre infrastructure assessment?
body: An assessment can be useful before an expansion, infrastructure refresh, remediation project, migration or major deployment.
It can also help when the environment has changed repeatedly and existing documentation no longer provides enough visibility.

items.title: Can Ideal Solutions audit an operational data centre?
body: Yes. Assessment activities can be planned around an existing operational environment, subject to site procedures, access requirements and the agreed scope.

items.title: Does an infrastructure audit include remediation?
body: Not automatically.

The audit identifies and documents agreed infrastructure conditions. Physical corrective work can then be handled separately through services such as Rack & Cabling Remediation, Network Infrastructure or Data Centre Deployment.

items.title: What information should we provide before the assessment?
body: Useful information can include the reason for the assessment, affected racks or areas, available infrastructure records, known concerns and the decisions the assessment is expected to support.

closing.title: See the Environment Clearly Before Deciding What Comes Next.
closing.body: Whether you are preparing for expansion, correcting existing infrastructure or trying to understand what is really onsite, Ideal Solutions helps turn physical infrastructure conditions into clearer next actions.
